title: Homelab
about: For machines and services you run yourself: compose files, logs and backups in your workspace.

sections.title: Services
sections.text: The compose files in your workspace, newest first. Open one to read it.

sections.title: Logs
sections.text: The .log files in your workspace, newest first: read these first when something breaks.

sections.title: Backups
sections.text: Files in your workspace with backup in the name, newest first: the newest one is your last backup.
